item.thunderrelics.royal_helmet.tooltip: When an enemy targets you: summon decorative lightning at the enemy, dealing 10 damage and setting it on fire for 10 seconds.
item.thunderrelics.royal_chestplate.tool: When hurt, 30% chance to summon decorative lightning at the enemy, dealing 3 damage and setting it on fire for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 1 second.
item.thunderrelics.royal_leggings.toolti: While raining or in water: gain Regeneration I and Strength II.
item.thunderrelics.royal_boots.tooltip: Gain Speed II and walk across water on a short-lived ice layer.
item.thunderrelics.royal_glaive.tooltip: Hold right-click to throw. On hit, deal 1.5× your attack damage, then summon decorative lightning against nearby enemies.
